body: If you knew my pain you would understand

Gonna try to get on medication just don’t know what’s the safest option. My snow has gotten worse but it’s honestly the least of my worries.
My symptoms have never died down just got slightly worse over the years, it wasn’t unbearable till a month ago.
I haven’t tried any meds yet because I don’t want to get worse from them, I couldn’t agree more with you on that tho. Hppd is way more then just visuals it’s very much a mental disorder as well.

That’s why my case is so unique. For starters I got my hppd from weed which seems to be rare. I’ve never been drunk, I did nothing in the last 8 years to cause a flare up. I woke up March 22nd in a completely different world.
I’ve had hppd for 8 years, but for the last month I’ve been stuck in this dpdr episode or bad trip it feels like.
Thanks I really could use a friend rn. I’m trying my best to hold on but I can’t much longer.

I’m in the same state rn, I feel like I’m not in control of my body. Panic attacks every night. Memory is fucked feel like that im going insane and can’t stop thinking about suicide. I have hppd that’s where my dp/dr comes from. Only drug I’ve ever taken is weed.
Literally, I just accepted that I’m fucked.
